footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to DiamondRock: includes a $1.2M income tax benefit; after $509K attributable to noncontrolling interests, $9.8M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.8% to $1.1B in 2025. Operating income rose 46.5% to $163M, a 14.5% margin.
Net income rose 2.4× to $91.6M, or $0.44 per share. Operating cash flow was $244M and free cash flow $162M, versus $143M; DiamondRock returned $135M through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $1.2M tax benefit.
sources: DiamondRock Hospitality Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
